verdict.rationale: Vercel ships its own event-triggered automations: deploy-on-push from connected Git repos, registrable webhooks that fire HTTP POSTs on deployment and project events, and firewall custom rules that act on traffic. There is no documented general-purpose, user-defined rule engine for 'when event X, do action Y' across the platform; Workflows that 'wait for external events' are a developer building block and earn no credit. missing for 10: a general user-configurable event→action rules engine, documented rule conditions/actions beyond deploys, webhooks and firewall blocking, AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A webhook is a trigger-based HTTP endpoint configured to receive HTTP POST requests through events.
Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Block attacks, scrapers, and unwanted traffic with custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets.
